correctness.rationale: Exact branch-odds transformation and order preservation hold for every alpha>2 and x>y. While the losing branch is not switched, r-1 increases by at least factor 3/2, giving the explicit entry bound. Once switched, the gap alpha(1+z_next)-(1+z)(1+w) is at least alpha-2>0, so the branch is invariant. All orbit and fixed-point log odds lie in U<=-log(alpha-1), V<=0; mean-value coefficients are in the stated closed intervals. A two-step norm estimate contracts by 3/4+1/(2alpha)<1. This is a complete infinite proof; exact-rational and floating checks separately confirm finite instances.
